title: Commissioners
description:
A multiplayer shooter made in Unity, with Steam integration for lobbies and networking. It has bots, a gun range, bullet holes, grazes and ricochets, characters with faces whose mouths move as they talk in chat, and support for mods.
Alongside the game I built the Commissioners hub: a site where players download public and tester builds, browse and upload mods, post on the forum and manage their accounts, with an admin panel for roles, private builds and moderation.
howItWorks:
The game uses Unity's Netcode for GameObjects over the Facepunch Steamworks transport.
The hub is a Next.js and TypeScript site backed by Supabase for accounts, roles, file storage and the forum, deployed on Vercel.
